dct_description_sm: Offers a geographic representation of the York Region Transit and VIVA Route locations. The bus route information is maintained in the Trapeze FX Application within the Transit Branch of the Transportation Services Department of York Region. This is the converted into a GTFS feed. This feed is converted to GIS data. As this data is not maintained or created in a GIS environment, topological issues within this dataset or with York Region data may occur.
